'''Colonel Fuhrberger''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
According to his own quotes, Fuhrberger is a former colonel who served during the {{WP|Vietnam War}}, and now resides at a [[Colonel Fuhrberger's House|house]] in [[East Beach]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]]. He still possesses military memorabilia and surplus weapons and ammunition, a fact discovered by [[LB]], a member of the [[Grove Street Families]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
{{Main|Home Invasion}}
[[Ryder]], looking for a way to provide the gang with military-grade weapons instead of [[Emmet]]'s stock to assist the Families against the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] gang, was informed by LB of Fuhrberger's stock. [[Carl Johnson]], a member of the Grove Street Families, entered his home with Ryder's assistance, and stole a few crates containing weaponry, before escaping in a black [[BoxBurg|Boxville]] before sunrise. The colonel is never seen nor mentioned again after the mission.

During the mission, Fuhrberger can be seen sleeping in his bedroom. If the player makes too much noise once, he will be yelling ''Get off my ridge, you Vietcong bastards!'', which could indicate that he suffers from mental trouble following the end of the Vietnam War. It also suggests that he was permanently traumatized by war. If the player makes too much noise once again, Fuhrberger will notice CJ. If the player has collected less than three crates, Carl will escape the house, but Ryder will escape with the Boxville without CJ, and the mission will fail. If the player attempts to kill him, this will not work, as doing so will automatically trigger the cutscene where Fuhrberger wakes up, and the mission fails. Fuhrberger can be killed only after collecting three crates, but doing so won't affect the storyline. After killing him, the player can collect his [[Shotgun (3D Universe)|shotgun]].

His house can be accessed at any time, before or after the mission.

==Trivia==
*His name is a play on 'fur burger', slang for a hairy vagina.
*If the colonel isn't killed and too much noise was made, Ryder will claim that he called the [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|cops]].
*The player can kill Fuhrberger without failing the mission even before collecting three crates, but only if they use a [[Sniper Rifle]], [[Rocket Launcher (3D Universe)|Rocket Launcher]]<ref>https://youtu.be/9hFgQ3tA-qk?si=NjiAa82j-3kDzmho&t=133</ref> or [[Heat-Seeking Rocket Launcher]].<ref>https://youtu.be/9hFgQ3tA-qk?si=BEUf_f18qCvBcJiP&t=188</ref> He will still shout a warning first, but will be dead nonetheless, and the noise meter will not move for the rest of the mission.
*Additionally, the player can kill Fuhrberger by throwing a [[Tear Gas|tear gas]] three times at direct impact, without triggering him.<ref>https://youtu.be/9hFgQ3tA-qk?si=oWRBET1KXe1Svlwx&t=313</ref>
*He has a poster of [[Candy Suxxx (3D Universe)|Candy Suxxx]] from ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]]'' in his room. The same poster can be found in various places in [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]].
*If the player provokes him after having stolen at least three crates, he will shout "This one's for Kenny!" though who exactly Kenny is is unknown.
*Colonel Fuhrberger might appear as a target during [[Vigilante in GTA San Andreas|Vigilante]] missions.
